sourceNotes: Existing SKP edited directly, all root-04 loose furnishings removed.
Installed wall finishes mapped from site photos/videos and same nine-page detail PDF; site folder contains media, not a separate SKP.
Floor retains the embedded dark polished fine-vein finish. Its 1200x600 texture repeat is a visualization parameter, not a measured tile schedule.
New C3 XY rounded from user annotation to16200,9900mm; section350x428 and height3150 are adjustable placeholders, not measured. Existing C1/C2 retained.
Installed track-light form and observed wall associations represented; exact offsets, counts and aiming remain adjustable. Uninstalled hanging fixtures removed with furnishings.

White wall infill and five rectangular-height window zones replace full-height glazing in two curved bays; retained CAD footprint, provisional sill850/head2500. High shell elevations retained pending measured section.
Independent TV/dining room shown in photos cannot be mapped reliably to this retained plan and is not inserted into another room.
PDF flower graphics extracted with original alpha masks and placed using explicit rotated UVs; mirrored reflections are represented by a bronze base.
Entrance revision based on VIDEO-2026-10-22-19-35-42(1).mp4 (V05), native sampled frames and PDF V4/V1 details.
Added two continuous recessed S ceiling bands, local white dropped ceiling, paired straight junction edges, and multi-slot HVAC. No invented luminous cove lighting.
The prior7100 high roof/shell remains. Added local2890 low plane and3070 recess backing, using known living levels as adjustable visual fits; east high-window bay remains open.
C3 remains at16200,9900; local header runs along pointed-bay baselineX16200. Its450x400 section,3150 underside,and end positions are inferred visual fit,not structural or surveyed dimensions.
V4 follows original4176mm detail chain in correct screen orientation, east anchoredX12829;500 strip11329..11829,hidden-door cladding8845..10024.47mm western mismatch retained without scaling.
The entrance dark side panel/open leaf/header proportions are fitted from video;2500 clear head retained. Timber species/color code unknown.
Existing Site_Greige surfaces now use a subtle retained texture approximation; no assertion of exact photographed wood grain.
